requirement: Provide a browser-accessed web platform with collaborating front-end, back-end, and algorithm-support modules, using Neo4j and MySQL for model, evolution-relationship, and user data.

The system shall manage account lifecycle and role state for learners, contributors, and administrators, including registration, login, logout, password modification, and permission-change application submission.
User login shall use two-factor authentication and OAuth 2.0 or a similar security protocol.

The system shall enforce login-gated and role-based authorization for model and evolution-data modification, including rejection of unauthorized deletions, modification attempts, forged login data, and tampering.

The system shall support model search and viewing, including textual display of model basic attributes and performance metrics, and topology-based visualization of model evolution relationships and detailed structural changes.
Contributors shall be able to upload ONNX files, upload and edit PyTorch source code online, and modify model profiles.

The system shall support adding, deleting, and modifying model evolution relationships and internal layer-reuse relationships, while recording associated datasets, trained-model information, and structural-change details for later visualization.
Administrators shall be able to manage users, delete users, and review and adjust user permission changes.
The back end shall persist machine-learning model artifacts, model basic attributes, and model performance metrics as retrievable domain data.
The system shall protect sensitive data in transit and at rest and encrypt stored models.
